sources.title: WIN Semiconductors — Foundry Service
sources.effective_period: WIN says it has been the world’s largest 150 mm GaAs pure-play foundry since 2007; the page also refers to capacity exceeding 340,000 wafers in 2018 and over 50% of global GaAs foundry demand, without dating that share figure.
sources.note: Official company statement; its specific ranking is limited to 150 mm pure-play GaAs foundry and does not disclose a ranking methodology.

sources.title: Morningstar — Win Semiconductors Corp 3105, Company Profile
sources.note: States WIN had over 50% share in the GaAs foundry market in 2025 and was followed by Advanced Wireless Semiconductor and GCS Holdings; does not specify the share denominator or methodology.
